Owner confirmation: none of the 65 approved repository transfer targets currently uses Azure Pipelines, Fly.io or Railway. Franz supplied this explicit fact on October 6, 2026.

This resolves those three provider-usage candidates. Captured installed App access remains in the historical inventory and candidate columns; it is not treated as evidence of active resources. No further Azure sign-in or project identification is required for this absence confirmation.

This receipt does not waive the other mandatory pre-transfer gates, including known Vercel/Supabase/Blacksmith resources, the yahtzee self-hosted runner, existing credential validity, repository references, or owned SFL App cutover readiness. No repository or App has been transferred by this confirmation.

Machine-readable record of the same previously confirmed owner fact. This adds no new permission or scope.
